test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A single discount equivalent to three successive discounts i.e. 7%, 12% and 5% is:
solution:
**Given:**

Three successive discounts are 7%, 12%, and 5%

**Concept used:**

Discount = original value × (1 - R%)

Where R% = rate of discount percent

If R₁ and R₂ are two rates of discounts, then

Successive rate of discount = R₁ + R₂ - R₁R₂/100

**Calculation:**

Let the original value be 100

Applying discounts

⇒ Discounted value = 100 × (100 - 7)/100 × (100 - 12)/100 × (100 - 5)/100

⇒ (93 × 88 × 95)/10000

⇒ 77.748

Equivalent discount = (100 - 77.748)/100 × 100 = 22.252% 

∴ A single Equivalent discount of three successive discounts of 7%, 12% and 5% is 22.252%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**If X% and Y% are two different rate of discounts. Then,

Effective Rate of discount = X + Y - XY/100

Effective discount rate of 7% and 12% will be

⇒ 7 + 12 - (7 × 12)/100

⇒ 19 - 0.84 = 18.16%

Now, the effective discount rate of 18.16% and 5%

⇒ 18.16 + 5 - (18.16 × 5)/100

⇒ 23.16 - 0.908 = 22.252 %

**∴ A single Equivalent discount of three successive discounts of 7%, 12% and 5% is 22.252%.**
